title: Spectre made CPUs leak through their own predictions
body: The 2018 Spectre attacks tricked branch predictors into speculatively executing secret-dependent code, then read the secret from cache timing left behind. The processor did everything 'correctly'; the microarchitecture's invisible state was the vulnerability. Mitigations cost real performance for years. Performance features are attack surface wearing a speed costume.
source_hint: Horn / Kocher et al., Spectre disclosures (2018)
